chain.title: El Paso County ROW permit terms (epc-rowpermit.com)

geometry.note: Genuine MUTCD-deferral: no county work-zone geometry located; Engineering Criteria Manual Ch. 2 is permanent transportation design. Edition note: the county's Part-6 typical applications still reference the 2009 MUTCD (superseded reference; does not change the legal default).

hours.override_note: No published work-hour windows. The application captures 'Time Area will be Occupied/Closed (i.e. 9am-4pm)' — occupancy times are an application field, not a published restriction.

hazards.rule: Incomplete applications go back to the end of the review queue — a lead-time penalty rather than a fee.

formula.note: Total permit fee = Degradation + Traffic Management + Administration + $25 surcharge. The Traffic Management fee is keyed to shoulder vs. number of lanes closed per day, with closure length 'based on minimum Work Zone called out in the MUTCD' — the engine's computed zone length is a direct fee input. Degradation: asphalt priced per SF by pavement age x length x (width + 2 ft); separate schedules for asphalt/gravel/chip-seal. The lane count consumed here is the plan's real closed-lane count from the engine, never a literal.
